name: Tourist Visa and Business Visa (ETA)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an approved Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) or visa for sightseeing, holidays, family visits, medical treatment, or cultural/sports events; single or double entry.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for an ETA online via eta.gov.lk before travel.

requirements.blocker_text: Purpose must be a qualifying business activity: meetings/negotiations, conferences/workshops/seminars, short-term training, or religious/art/symposium events -- not employment.
Requires a host company invitation letter, return ticket, and bank statement.

outcome.duration_length: Tourist: not specified precisely in the source located. Short-term Business Visa: 30 days, multiple entries. Long-term Business Visa: up to 90 days, single/double/multiple entries. Reciprocal Visa for US nationals: up to 5 years, multiple entries.

sources.title: Department of Immigration & Emigration, Sri Lanka -- General Information on Visa: Tourist Visa (sightseeing, holidays, family visits, medical treatment, cultural/sports events, single or double entry) and Business Visa (single/double/multiple journeys) as the two main Visit Visa categories; passport valid 6+ months, adequate financial resources, return travel documentation required generally

Permanent Mission of Sri Lanka to the United Nations (official mission page) -- Business Visa: Short-term (30 days multiple entry, $30 processing + $55 reciprocal for non-SAARC, SAARC exempt from reciprocal fee, 2-4 day processing, online via eta.gov.lk or Consular Division), Long-term (up to 90 days, Consular Division only), and a 5-year Reciprocal Visa for US nationals ($140)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Sri Lanka). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Department of Immigration & Emigration and an official mission page). SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation) member-state nationals are exempt from the reciprocal fee component -- a regional preference consistent with the EAC/ECOWAS preferences found in Kenya, Uganda, and Ghana built earlier in this dataset. GENUINE GAP: the plain Tourist Visa's exact duration was not specified precisely in the sources retrieved (only the Business Visa sub-durations were), disclosed rather than guessed.
